forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {噂|うわさ}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: Unverified information spread from person to person.
What people say about someone or something.

notes:
{噂|うわさ} refers to unverified information passed between people. It covers both negative gossip and neutral reputation/word-of-mouth.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噂|うわさ}する

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {噂|うわさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to hear a rumor
- {噂|うわさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧: a rumor spreads
- {噂|うわさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become the subject of rumors
- {噂|うわさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to gossip
- {噂|うわさ}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: as rumored, as people say
- {噂|うわさ}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧: according to rumors

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {噂|うわさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧: Speak of the devil (lit. "gossip about someone and their shadow appears")
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{噂|うわさ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{七十五日|しちじゅうごにち}→七十五日：noentry⟧: rumors die down after 75 days (time heals all gossip)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧: reputation, public opinion (more established, often about quality)
- ⟦ゴシップ→ゴシップ：27923_goshippu⟧: gossip (loanword, often about celebrities)
